017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.console;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.util.*;
022
023import org.apache.juneau.marshall.collections.*;
024import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.console.*;
025import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.terminal.*;
026
027/**
028 * The built-in {@code terminal} card type: validates a {@code {contractVersion:'1', terminal:{...}}} body through
029 * {@link TerminalDef} and emits {@code {terminal: ...}}. {@code id=} is required and {@code src=}/{@code template=}
030 * are rejected by {@code <@card>} itself before this handler runs.
031 *
032 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
033 * <p class='bcode'>
034 *    &lt;@card type="terminal" id="build"&gt;{ contractVersion: '1', terminal: { bytesUrl: '/runs/juneau-terminal/r42/bytes' } }&lt;/@card&gt;
035 * </p>
036 *
037 * @since 10.0.0
038 */
039@SuppressWarnings({
040   "java:S1192" // Repeated literals are contract wire keys; named constants would obscure the contract shape.
041})
042public final class TerminalCardType implements CardTypeHandler {
043
044   private static final Set<String> BODY_KEYS = new LinkedHashSet<>(List.of("contractVersion", "terminal"));
045
046   /** Public no-arg constructor, required by {@link java.util.ServiceLoader}. */
047   public TerminalCardType() {
048      // No state; instantiated by ServiceLoader.
049   }
050
051   @Override
052   public String type() {
053      return "terminal";
054   }
055
056   /**
057    * The roles a terminal card may subscribe with: {@code input-status}, the answer to a {@code term.input} frame, and
058    * {@code nudge}, the server's notice that a terminal's bytes have grown.
059    *
060    * <p>
061    * This set must match the {@code roles} on the terminal card handler in {@code juneau-terminal.js}, so the build-time
062    * and browser role checks agree.
063    *
064    * @return {@code Set.of("input-status", "nudge")}.
065    */
066   @Override
067   public Set<String> acceptedRoles() {
068      return Set.of("input-status", "nudge");
069   }
070
071   @Override
072   @SuppressWarnings({
073      "unchecked" // JSON5 object keys are always strings.
074   })
075   public JsonMap toFragment(CardSource source) {
076      if (! source.hasJsonBody())
077         throw source.error("type='terminal' requires a JSON5 body { contractVersion: '1', terminal: {...} }.");
078      var envelope = source.json();
079      for (var k : envelope.keySet())
080         if (! BODY_KEYS.contains(k))
081            throw source.error("type='terminal' unknown key '%s'; allowed: contractVersion, terminal.", k);
082      var version = envelope.get("contractVersion");
083      if (! eq("1", version))
084         throw source.error("type='terminal' requires contractVersion: '1'; got '%s'.", version);
085      if (! (envelope.get("terminal") instanceof Map<?,?> terminal))
086         throw source.error("type='terminal' requires a terminal object.");
087      var def = TerminalDef.fromMap(source.id(), (Map<String,?>)terminal).validate();
088      var frag = new JsonMap();
089      frag.put("terminal", def.toMap());
090      return frag;
091   }
092}
